title: AGENTS.md
text: Public operations use cell_ prefix; constructors use hex_. Keep API small H3-like naming. Variable-size results always tibbles keep source column (origin, parent); never switch return type based input length. Coordinates longitude first, latitude. Raise errors .abort() classed globalhex_error_* subclass, using cli formatting. Validate arguments helpers R/conditions.R. Deduplicate inputs batch resolution calling DGGRID; avoid one subprocess per cell. Restore original order output. Long operations accept progress = NULL/TRUE/FALSE use internal .progress_* helpers. bundled DGGRID GDAL: use TEXT/GEOJSON/AIGEN/SHAPEFILE inputs outputs metafiles, never GDAL types. sf, terra, exactextractr, dggridR Suggests : guard rlang::check_installed(). Internal helpers start . documented @noRd. man/ NAMESPACE roxygen-generated; edit roxygen comments, generated files. Add NEWS.md bullet user-visible changes.

title: AGENTS.md
text: Vector inputs deduplicated calling DGGRID restored input order afterwards. Hierarchy traversal batch resolution depth. Point, center, boundary, sequence-number requests run bounded chunks. Centers use DGGRID’s TEXT output; boundaries use GEOJSON. Parent lookup local string operation Z7/Z3 IDs (DGGRID call). Plotting picks display level cell centers, aggregates locally, asks DGGRID boundaries final display cells. render = "auto" rasterizes raster_threshold (20,000) cells terra available. raster_to_cell() pads DGGRID’s nucleus-based cover one neighbor ring, drops cells intersecting raster footprint. Full-longitude rasters use whole-grid generation instead clipping polygon.

title: Getting started with globalhex
text: Resolution 0 coarsest level. step finer divides every cell seven, cells shrink quickly: grid equal-area, areas hold everywhere Earth, equator poles. grid built icosahedron, 12 cells every resolution pentagons rather hexagons. cell operations use cell_ prefix rather hex_: every cell hexagon. Pentagons five neighbors instead six, globalhex handles like cell.

title: globalhex 0.0.0.9000
text: Bundled DGGRID 9.03b source, compiled without GDAL install time, separate DGGRID installation needed. package now AGPL-3.0--later. cell_cover() clips DGGRID’s AIGEN format applies polygon holes R, keeping cells islands inside holes. Fixed automatic plot resolution failing (“source cells visible”) wide regional datasets, North Atlantic storm tracks. Fixed raster_to_cell() failing rasters narrower 60 degrees cross multiple 60 degrees longitude. point_to_cell() recognizes long column longitude. New README rendered examples, three vignettes: getting started, plotting, rasters polygons. Added IGEO7/Z7-first API DGGRID 9.x. Added ISEA3H/Z3 selection partial dggridR compatibility fallback. Added conversion, boundary, neighbor, traversal, hierarchy, sf, polygon fill helpers H3-like snake-case names. Reworked cells vctrs vectors supporting mixed resolutions. Separated grid identity DGGRID backend configuration. Standardized cell operations cell_ grammar type-stable relation tibbles. Made legacy dggridR fallback explicit added classed cli errors. Deduplicated point, sequence-number, relation, geometry requests invoking backends preserving original result order. Batched hierarchy graph traversal work resolution search depth, including shared searches repeated distance origins. Standardized optional-package checks rlang’s package-checking API. Switched center extraction GeoJSON compact DGGRID text output added bounded internal chunks large point, center, boundary, sequence-number requests. Added delayed cli progress hierarchy, graph traversal, distance, polygon-cover operations without adding runtime dependency. Added cell_grid() fast backend-confirmed cell_is_valid() helpers. Added regression coverage 12 pentagons, seam-crossing antimeridian cells, polar cells, larger graph radii, forced multi-chunk execution. Added development-bench harness excluded package builds. Added lazy hex_data() tables base plot() method constructs geometry hierarchical aggregation. Added cell_aggregate() viewport/device-aware plot_resolution() numeric, logical, categorical aggregation semantics. Made parent lookup local Z7/Z3 index operation, removing DGGRID process parent aggregation level--detail selection. Added center-viewport selection, antimeridian handling, projection aggregation, fixed-resolution plotting, lod = FALSE escape hatch. Added 100 thousand, 1 million, 10 million row plotting benchmarks naive fine-polygon comparison. Added cell_sample() fast center-point extraction SpatRaster layers without cell polygons. Added cell_extract() exact raster-pixel coverage area-weighted continuous defaults categorical mode extraction. Added raster_to_cell() edge-cell padding, projected-raster support, 0--360 longitude handling; raster helpers return lazy globalhex_data objects. Made full-longitude raster conversion enumerate bounded whole DGGS instead sending globe-spanning polygons DGGRID’s clipper. Added controllable cell_cover() edge densification made long DGGRID failures safe concise retaining full diagnostic text. Made raster conversion drop -missing cells default made plotting ignore missing values LOD selection, avoiding needless downsampling sparse global rasters. Added render = "auto", "polygon", "raster" plotting. Automatic mode rasterizes large display layers optional terra, keeps explicit borders vector-based, records renderer returned data.
